blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has imposed new restrictions on military cooperation with Canada, according to US media, as the Pentagon said Saturday it was refocusing the relationship around American defense priorities. Hegseth issued the directive in a classified memo circulated last week, The Washington Post reported Friday, citing officials familiar with the decision.
